description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aHlcMMNQ85VLK7QT]{Timber Sentinel} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree}

Your protector tree stands for 1 minute. Whenever an ally adjacent to the tree is hit by a Strike, the tree interposes its branches and takes the damage first. Any additional damage beyond what it takes to reduce the tree to 0 Hit Points is dealt to the original target.

When this effect ends, the tree remains as an ordinary, non-magical tree if it's in soil. If you use Timber Sentinel again, the previous tree's effect ends.
